label: Yield with spares
subgoals: Model the fault count as Poisson with mean lambda
Sum the Poisson probabilities up to the number of spares
Note the optimistic assumptions of fault-free spares and one spare per fault

label: Sizing the redundancy
subgoals: Accumulate the Poisson cumulative distribution term by term
Stop at the first count that meets the target
Weigh the spare area against the recovered yield

Sum the binomial probabilities of at most s failures
Compare with the yield of the same chip without spares
